name: The Bots of Primal Pursuit
summary: TBPP is a horror based gorilla tag fan game meant to get scared and have fun! Lore: It is 2053 you are born as a baby monkey, under neural review at Scheme Labs. Unfortunately, there was a nuclear meltdown at a nearby powerplant. Now they have to do the research digitally, after transferring  your consciousness to a mechanical body bringing you here today, after the downfall of Scheme Labs.
